liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Clementine (several takes, a couple with vocals by Phil)** (1 other source): Several takes of Clementine exist, and a couple feature Phil on vocals [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **Clementine (many takes)**: rare: 7 archived performances [3]
- **Clementine (several takes, a couple with vocals by Phil)**: rare: 7 archived performances [3]
- **Space like jam with some improvised vocals**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [3]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-09-12.136643.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 3 songs; 44 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording excellent in quality [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the band sounds like they are enjoying themselves during the session [2]
- Dead.net tapers section describes a studio jam with Phil, Jerry, Mickey and a couple of guest musicians, during the Mickey and the Hartbeats period [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-09-12.136643.sbd.mr.dat48k.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > 7 inch Master Reel @ 7.5ips 1/2 track > dat(48k) [1]. Also: This version came from an anonymous source; the tape is labeled 09/12/69 but is almost certainly 1968 [1]
